selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 驱散敌方目标身上的魔法，移除1个增益魔法效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Dispels Magic on the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 控制一个等级不超过你的等级+1的目标，持续30秒，同时保持自身清醒。对恶魔、机械或亡灵类目标或玩家无效。此法术与其他迷惑类法术共享递减效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Controls a mind up to 1 level above yours for 30 sec while still controlling your own mind. Does not work versus Demonic, Mechanical, or Undead beings or players. This spell shares diminishing returns with other disorienting effects.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使你的智力提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your Intellect by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 大部分法术的射程提高15%。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
神圣,  暗影
对自己施放快速治疗会使你受到的所有伤害降低10%，持续10秒。

 戒律
对自己施放快速治疗或暗影愈合会使你受到的所有伤害降低10%，持续10秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Holy,  Shadow
Casting Flash Heal on yourself reduces all damage you take by 10% for 10 sec.

 Discipline
Casting Flash Heal or Shadow Mend on yourself reduces all damage you take by 10% for 10 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 20%的快速治疗对其他目标造成的治疗也会治疗你。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 从绝望祷言中获得的最大生命值提高10%。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 绝望祷言的冷却时间缩短20秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Desperate Prayer by 20 sec.

Infuses the target with power for 15 sec, increasing haste by 20%.

Can only be cast on players.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 渐隐术会使你受到的伤害降低10%。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 渐隐术的冷却时间缩短(5))秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Fade by (5)) sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使你的耐力提高6%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your Stamina by 6%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的神圣和暗影法术的伤害和治疗效果提高2%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the damage and healing of your Holy and Shadow spells by 2%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 暗言术：灭对你造成的伤害降低50%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Shadow Word: Death deals 50% less damage to you.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
戒律,  神圣
黑暗的咒语，对目标造成([85% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害。如果目标没有被暗言术：灭消灭，则你会受到相当于最大生命值5%的反噬伤害。

对生命值低于20%的目标造成的伤害提高150%。

 暗影
黑暗的咒语，对目标造成([85% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害。如果目标没有被暗言术：灭消灭，则你会受到相当于最大生命值5%的反噬伤害。

对生命值低于20%的目标造成的伤害提高150%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Discipline,  Holy
A word of dark binding that inflicts (85% of Spell Power) Shadow damage to your target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 5% of your maximum health.

Damage increased by 150% to targets below 20% health.

 Shadow
A word of dark binding that inflicts (85% of Spell Power) Shadow damage to your target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 5% of your maximum health.

Damage increased by 150% to targets below 20% health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
神圣
冲击目标的心灵，造成([78.336% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害。

selectedNodes.descriptionEn:

Blast the target's mind for (78.336% of Spell Power) Shadow damage.

 Discipline
Blast the target's mind for (78.336% of Spell Power) Shadow damage. Costs a high amount of mana.

 Shadow
Blast the target's mind for (78.336% of Spell Power) Shadow damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 拉拽一名小队或团队成员的灵魂，使其立即移动到你面前。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Pulls the spirit of a party or raid member, instantly moving them directly in front of you.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 心灵尖啸不再使敌人因恐惧而逃跑，而是在原地颤栗。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Psychic Scream causes enemies to tremble in place instead of fleeing in fear.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
当对盟友使用能量灌注时，你也会获得100%效果。

如果没有盟友被选中为目标，会以100%的效果赐予附近的一个盟友，优先选择伤害输出者。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Power Infusion also grants you its effect at 100% value when used on an ally. 

If no ally is targeted, it will grant its effect at 100% value to a nearby ally, preferring damage dealers.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使你对敌对生物施展的精神控制和统御意志的持续时间延长15秒。

 Holy
Prayer of Mending and Leap of Faith increase your target's movement speed by 40% for 3 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
以虚空齐射轰炸目标，并以虚空魔法扭曲你的暗影形态，使你的法术伤害提高20%，持续20秒。

虚空形态下，虚空齐射将取代此法术，最多可使用3次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Bombards your target with a Void Volley and twists your Shadowform with void magic, increasing your spell damage by 20% for 20 sec. 

During Voidform, Void Volley replaces this spell and can be used up to 3 times.

subSpellsCn.name: 虚空齐射
subSpellsCn.description:
释放一股纯粹虚空能量汇集的齐射，向你的目标发射10发飞弹，并向你目标10码范围内所有敌人额外发射1发飞弹，每发造成([95.44% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害。

产生10点狂乱值。

subSpellsEn.name: Void Volley
subSpellsEn.description:
Releases a volley of pure void energy, firing 10 bolts at your target and 1 bolt at all enemies within 10 yards of your target for (95.44% of Spell Power) Shadow damage.

Generates 10 Insanity.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当暗言术：痛、暗言术：癫和吸血鬼之触同时作用于同一个目标时，你的心灵震爆、虚空洪流、精神鞭笞和虚空齐射会额外造成20%的伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: While you have Shadow Word: Pain, Shadow Word: Madness, and Vampiric Touch active on the same target, your Mind Blast, Void Torrent, Mind Flay, and Void Volley deal 20% more damage.

你对敌人施放有害法术时创造惊魂幻象。

惊魂幻象达到50层时，你的目标会看到噩梦，受到([182% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害，并在3秒内为你产生2点狂乱值。

达到100层时，你的目标会见证恩佐斯的幻象，受到([689% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害，并在3秒内为你产生6点狂乱值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
You create Horrific Visions when casting harmful spells on enemies.

At 50 stacks of Horrific Visions, your target sees a nightmare, dealing (182% of Spell Power) Shadow damage and granting you 2 Insanity over 3 sec.

At 100 stacks, your target witnesses a vision of N'Zoth, dealing (689% of Spell Power) Shadow damage and granting you 6 Insanity over 3 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 心灵震爆、精神鞭笞和暗言术：灭的爆击率提高4%，爆击伤害提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the critical strike chance of Mind Blast, Mind Flay, and Shadow Word: Death by 4% and increases their critical strike damage by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:

超过5个目标后伤害递减。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Shadowy Apparitions that float towards your primary target explode, dealing (140% of Spell Power) Shadow damage to all enemies within 8 yds.

Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 暗言术：癫的狂乱值消耗降低5点。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the Insanity cost of Shadow Word: Madness by 5.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 暗言术：癫使你的暗言术：痛和吸血鬼之触对所有目标造成伤害的速度提高40%，持续3秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Shadow Word: Madness causes your Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch to deal damage 40% faster on all targets for 3 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 暗言术：癫召唤出暗影幻灵，向所有受到你的吸血鬼之触影响的目标飘去，造成([85.05% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害。

selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Tentacle Slam deals 50% increased damage and Void Volley deals 15% increased damage.

When Voidform ends, you can cast Void Volley 1 additional time within 30 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
暗影幻灵的伤害提高10%。

暗影幻灵造成伤害时，你对目标施加的暗言术：痛与吸血鬼之触的持续时间延长1.0秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Shadowy Apparition damage increased by 10%.

When Shadowy Apparitions deal damage, they extend the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch on the target by 1.0 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 暗言术：癫的伤害提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases Shadow Word: Madness damage by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 吸血鬼之触造成的伤害提高20%，并且每次造成伤害都有几率产生1点狂乱值。

对暗影幻灵、暗言术：痛和吸血鬼之触造成的伤害无效。

Your direct damage spells inflict 25% of their damage on all other targets afflicted by your Vampiric Touch within 40 yards.

Does not apply to damage from Shadowy Apparitions, Shadow Word: Pain, and Vampiric Touch.

如果重新施加此效果，所有剩余伤害都会添加到新的效果中。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
A word of madness haunts the target's mind, dealing (227.5% of Spell Power) Shadow damage instantly plus an additional 9 Shadow damage over 6 sec. Heals you for 30% of damage dealt.

When reapplied to a target, all remaining damage is added to the new effect.

selectedNodes.descriptionEn: After conjuring Shadowy Apparitions, gain a stack of Idol of Yogg-Saron. At 20 stacks, you summon a Thing from Beyond that casts Void Spike at nearby enemies for 20 sec.

Summons a massive shadowy appendage to slam the ground, dealing (68.7926% of Spell Power) Shadow damage in front of you and 8 yds around your target.

Applies Vampiric Touch to up to 6 enemies, prioritizing ones without Vampiric Touch.

神圣

 Shadow

selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Holy

subSpellsCn.name: 精神鞭笞：狂

持续期间产生8点狂乱值。

Assaults the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing (542.36% of Spell Power) Shadow damage over 1.5 sec and slowing their movement speed by 70%.

Generates 8 Insanity over the duration.

selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Halo now centers around you and returns to you after it reaches its maximum distance, healing allies and damaging enemies each time it passes through them.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 将神圣或暗影光晕扩大为环绕自身的执政官光环，显著延长强化形态并提升范围爆发。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Amplifies Halos into enduring luminous auras, substantially extending apotheosis/dark ascension and group efficacy.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 心灵尖啸在你的位置创造一个你的幻象。4秒后幻象将释放一次心灵尖啸。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Psychic Scream creates an image of you at your location. After 4 sec, the image will let out a Psychic Scream.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
神圣
创造一个光晕会使神圣化身的持续时间延长1秒。如果神圣化身未激活，最多可存储6秒。

未进入战斗或受到失控效果影响时，神圣化身的持续时间可暂停最多20秒。

 暗影
创造一个光晕会使虚空形态的持续时间延长1秒。如果虚空形态未激活，最多可存储6秒。

未进入战斗或受到失控效果影响时，虚空形态的持续时间可暂停最多20秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Holy
Creating a Halo extends the duration of Apotheosis by 1 sec. If Apotheosis is not active, up to 6 seconds is stored.

While out of combat or affected by a loss of control effect, the duration of Apotheosis is paused for up to 20 sec.

 Shadow
Creating a Halo extends the duration of Voidform by 1 sec. If Voidform is not active, up to 6 seconds is stored.

While out of combat or affected by a loss of control effect, the duration of Voidform is paused for up to 20 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 精神鞭笞的伤害提高25%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the damage of Mind Flay by 25%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
精神鞭笞造成伤害时使你的心灵震爆的爆击几率提高8%，最多叠加12次。

持续10秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Mind Flay damage increases the critical strike chance of Mind Blast by 8%, stacking up to 12 times.

Lasts 10 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的周期性法术伤害提高6%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your periodic spell damage by 6%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
暗言术：癫使你在虚空形态下的急速提高2%，持续时间延长1.5秒，最多可叠加5层。

虚空形态结束时，急速效果会逐渐消退，在10秒内衰减。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Shadow Word: Madness increases your haste during Voidform by 2% and increases its duration by 1.5 sec, stacking up to 5 times. 

When Voidform ends, the haste lingers and decays over 10 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 真言术：韧使你获得额外5%的耐力。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Power Word: Fortitude grants you an additional 5% stamina.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
神圣
治疗祷言的法力消耗降低10%，施法时间缩短15%。

 暗影
虚空齐射的伤害提高5%，且在虚空形态下施放暗言术：癫时，会向你的目标发射一次效果为25%的虚空齐射。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Holy
Prayer of Healing mana cost reduced by 10% and its cast time is reduced by 15%.

 Shadow
Void Volley deals 5% increased damage and Shadow Word: Madness casts during Voidform unleash a Void Volley at your target at 25% effectiveness.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在生命值为满的状态下，受到吸血鬼之触和暗言术：癫的治疗会产生吸收护盾，吸收等同于治疗量的伤害。护盾吸收的伤害不会超过你最大生命值的10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Healing from Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Madness when you are at maximum health will shield you for the same amount. The shield cannot exceed 10% of your maximum health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
神圣
圣光涌动现在除了可以被快速治疗消耗外，还可以被治疗祷言消耗。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Shadow
Increases Shadowy Apparition damage by 10%.

 Holy
Surge of Light can now be consumed by Prayer of Healing in addition to Flash Heal.

subSpellsCn.name: 圣光涌动
subSpellsCn.description: 你的治疗法术和惩击有8%的几率使你的下一个快速治疗变为瞬发，且消耗的法力值降低 [ 神圣: 50 / 50]%。最多可叠加2层。

subSpellsEn.name: Surge of Light
subSpellsEn.description: Your healing spells and Smite have a 8% chance to make your next Flash Heal instant and cost  [ Holy: 50 / 50]% less mana. Stacks to 2.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 触须猛击有100%的几率激活以下其中一个神像的效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Tentacle Slam has a 100% chance to activate an effect from one of your Idols.

subSpellsCn.name: 恩佐斯的神像
subSpellsCn.description: 你的目标会目睹一场梦魇或恩佐斯的幻象。

subSpellsCn.name: 克苏恩的神像
subSpellsCn.description: 召唤一个虚空触须或虚空鞭笞者。

subSpellsEn.name: Idol of N'Zoth
subSpellsEn.description: Your target witnesses a nightmare or vision of N'Zoth.

subSpellsEn.name: Idol of C'Thun
subSpellsEn.description: Summons a Void Tendril or Void Lasher.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 暗影幻灵有15%的几率变为虚空幻灵，对其目标施放
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Shadowy Apparitions have a 15% chance to spawn as Void Apparitions that release a

subSpellsCn.name: 虚空箭
subSpellsCn.description: 向目标射出一支纯粹的虚空能量箭，造成([150% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害。

subSpellsEn.name: Void Bolt
subSpellsEn.description: at their target and deal 50% increased damage.

subSpellsEn.name: Void Bolt
subSpellsEn.description: Sends a bolt of pure void energy at your target, dealing (150% of Spell Power) Shadow damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 神像的效果激活时，召唤暗影幻灵。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: When an effect from an Idol is activated, conjure Shadowy Apparitions.
